slots.claim_sentence: Interpreting visual scenes requires people to gather information from multiple locations.
slots.clarification_sentence: Many decisions need several fixations to collect details from different parts of a scene.

slots.clarification_sentence: Participants' scan paths depended on both the scene and the task demands.

slots.claim_sentence: Categorization improved when locations were chosen by an optimal Bayesian active sensor algorithm.
slots.clarification_sentence: The algorithm selected fixation points that best reduced uncertainty about the category.

slots.claim_sentence: Suboptimal fixation choices mainly result from prior biases, perceptual noise, and eye movement errors.
slots.clarification_sentence: The process of selecting fixation locations was about 70% efficient in the task.

slots.claim_sentence: Participants select eye movements to maximize information about abstract categories.
slots.clarification_sentence: This requires integrating information from multiple locations to guide eye movements.

slots.claim_sentence: Nucleocytoplasmic transport is tightly regulated by the nuclear pore complex (NPC).
slots.clarification_sentence: The NPC controls molecule movement between the nucleus and the rest of the cell.

slots.claim_sentence: The requirements for nuclear import of very large cargoes are not well understood.
slots.clarification_sentence: This includes the role of nuclear localisation sequences (NLSs) and cargo size on import efficiency.

slots.claim_sentence: The study tested nuclear import kinetics of 30 large cargo models based on four capsid-like particles.
slots.clarification_sentence: These cargoes ranged from 17 to 36 nm and had up to 240 NLSs on their surface.

slots.claim_sentence: A simple two-parameter biophysical model links import flux to the energy of large cargo transport through the NPC.
slots.clarification_sentence: This model explains how nuclear transport depends on cargo size and NLS number.

slots.claim_sentence: The results reveal key molecular determinants of large cargo import in cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: These determinants include factors related to cargo size and multivalent NLS interactions.

slots.claim_sentence: Cdc48 has a new function in ubiquitin-dependent regulation of mitochondrial dynamics.
slots.clarification_sentence: Mitochondrial dynamics include processes such as fusion and fission.

slots.claim_sentence: The DUBs Ubp12 and Ubp2 have opposing effects on mitochondrial fusion.
slots.clarification_sentence: They cleave different ubiquitin chains on the mitofusin Fzo1 protein.

slots.claim_sentence: Cdc48 integrates the activities of Ubp12 and Ubp2, which are themselves ubiquitylated.
slots.clarification_sentence: Ubiquitylation of the DUBs allows Cdc48 to regulate their function.

slots.claim_sentence: Cdc48 promotes proteolysis of Ubp12, stabilizing pro-fusion ubiquitylation on Fzo1.
slots.clarification_sentence: Proteolysis means breaking down the Ubp12 protein to maintain fusion-promoting tags on Fzo1.

slots.claim_sentence: Loss of Ubp12 stabilizes Ubp2 and helps remove ubiquitin chains on Fzo1 that inhibit fusion.
slots.clarification_sentence: When Ubp12 is absent, Ubp2 becomes more stable and removes inhibitory tags from Fzo1.

slots.claim_sentence: Cdc48 synergistically regulates Fzo1 ubiquitylation to balance mitochondrial fusion activation or repression.
This study reveals a new cascade involving Cdc48 and two DUBs that fine-tunes Fzo1's fusogenic activity.

slots.claim_sentence: Cilia and flagella are assembled and maintained by intraflagellar transport.
slots.clarification_sentence: Intraflagellar transport, or IFT, involves more than 20 proteins working together.

slots.claim_sentence: The functions of individual IFT proteins are mostly unclear.
This study focused on the IFT protein TTC26, also called DYF13.
TTC26/DYF13 is an IFT complex B protein in mammalian cells and algae.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was shown using live imaging and biochemical methods.

slots.claim_sentence: Reducing TTC26/DYF13 in zebrafish or mutating it in algae caused short cilia with abnormal movement.
slots.clarification_sentence: Affected zebrafish embryos had defects in eyes, ears, and kidneys.

slots.claim_sentence: IFT particle assembly and speed were normal in dyf13 mutant flagella.
slots.clarification_sentence: This differs from other IFT complex B mutants that show defects in these processes.

slots.claim_sentence: A specific set of motility-related proteins was missing in the dyf13 mutant.
slots.clarification_sentence: Proteomic and biochemical analyses identified these depleted proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: Different IFT proteins carry different cargo subsets in cilia and flagella.
slots.clarification_sentence: This explains why the IFT machinery involves many different proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: Lymphatic invasion and lymph node metastasis are linked to poor outcomes in melanoma.
slots.clarification_sentence: Lymph node metastasis indicates cancer spread through the lymphatic system.

slots.claim_sentence: The ways melanoma spreads through lymphatics to distant organs are not fully understood.
Growing WM852 melanoma cells with lymphatic endothelial cells in 3D promotes metastasis in mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: Lymphatic endothelial cells are the cells that line lymph vessels.

slots.claim_sentence: Metastatic melanoma cells adopt an invasively sprouting form in 3D that depends on MMP14, Notch3, and β1-integrin.
slots.clarification_sentence: This sprouting form helps melanoma cells invade surrounding tissue.

slots.claim_sentence: MMP14 is needed for lymphatic endothelial cells to trigger Notch3 and β1-integrin activation in melanoma.
slots.clarification_sentence: MMP14 acts before Notch3 in this activation process.

slots.claim_sentence: Both MMP14 and Notch3 are required for lymphatic endothelial cell-driven melanoma spread in zebrafish models.
slots.clarification_sentence: Reducing MMP14 or Notch3 lowers melanoma metastasis in these fish.

slots.claim_sentence: Contact with lymphatic endothelial cells causes melanoma cells to switch from 3D growth to an invasive sprouting form.
slots.clarification_sentence: This switch is reversible and promotes melanoma metastasis.

slots.claim_sentence: MicroRNAs are noncoding RNAs that regulate gene expression after transcription.

slots.claim_sentence: miR-9's role in dendritic and synaptic development was largely unknown.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers developed a transgenic miRNA sponge mouse to inactivate miR-9 conditionally.
slots.clarification_sentence: This mouse allows turning off miR-9 in specific places and times in living animals.

slots.claim_sentence: Using this mouse, miR-9 was found to control dendritic growth and synaptic transmission in vivo.
slots.clarification_sentence: Loss of miR-9 caused defects in dendrite growth and synaptic function.

slots.claim_sentence: miR-9 controls dendritic growth by downregulating the transcriptional repressor REST.
slots.clarification_sentence: REST normally blocks genes needed for dendrite growth, so miR-9 reduces REST to allow growth.

slots.claim_sentence: Social visual engagement difficulties are early signs of autism and can be measured using eye tracking.
slots.clarification_sentence: These difficulties are central in early ASD screening and diagnostic tools.

slots.claim_sentence: It is unclear how social visual engagement difficulties relate to early brain organization in autism.
slots.clarification_sentence: The study used resting state fMRI to examine brain connectivity in young children with autism.

slots.claim_sentence: Greater reduction in default mode to occipito-temporal connectivity relates to more severe social-communication difficulties in GeoPref ASD.
slots.clarification_sentence: This link is only seen in the GeoPref ASD subtype, not in other autism groups.

slots.claim_sentence: Early and strong social-visual circuit hypoconnectivity is a key feature of GeoPref ASD.
slots.clarification_sentence: This brain pattern may be critical for social development and could guide new early treatments.

slots.claim_sentence: In Drosophila melanogaster, the lymph gland produces plasmatocytes and crystal cells.

slots.claim_sentence: This transdifferentiation happens in sessile hemocyte clusters and needs their intact structure.
slots.clarification_sentence: Disrupting these clusters reduces crystal cell formation.

slots.claim_sentence: Sessile hemocyte clusters act as true hematopoietic tissue controlling blood cell balance.
slots.clarification_sentence: They use structure-dependent signaling to maintain blood homeostasis.

slots.claim_sentence: The hemocyte population expands in both circulation and sessile patches during larval development.

slots.claim_sentence: Aneuploidy is linked to many diseases but also helps organisms evolve.

Aneuploidy is common in wild yeast isolates, which show lower-than-expected expression at many amplified genes.

slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers made yeast strains with two, three, or four copies of certain chromosomes to test this.

slots.claim_sentence: Genes with dosage compensation are more tightly regulated but also show higher rates of gene amplification.
slots.clarification_sentence: This means copy-number variation is buffered at these genes in wild yeast populations.

slots.claim_sentence: Aneuploidy gives an ecological advantage to oak strain YPS1009 by amplifying a gene that escapes dosage compensation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This gene’s increased expression helps the yeast survive better in its environment.

slots.claim_sentence: Dosage compensation buffers gene amplification through aneuploidy, allowing rapid but likely temporary evolution.
slots.clarification_sentence: Dosage compensation constrains expression despite underlying gene amplification.

slots.claim_sentence: Xenopsin is a newly identified subtype of opsin that changes views on photoreceptor evolution.
slots.clarification_sentence: Its discovery has led to reevaluation of opsin and photoreceptor cell evolution.

slots.clarification_sentence: This reclassification is based on new understanding of their evolutionary history.

slots.claim_sentence: In the flatworm Maritigrella crozieri, xenopsin is found in larval eye cells and adult brain-area cells.

slots.claim_sentence: The adult extraocular cells contain hundreds of cilia inside a vacuole called a phaosome.

slots.clarification_sentence: This means xenopsin can detect light and start a cellular response.

slots.claim_sentence: Xenopsin and c-opsin share features and define a new cell type enclosing cilia within its plasma membrane.
slots.clarification_sentence: This cell type is like jawed vertebrate rod photoreceptors in structure.

slots.claim_sentence: The integration of spatial and temporal cues in neural progenitors to specify neuronal diversity is not well understood.
slots.clarification_sentence: Virtually nothing is known about how spatial and temporal factors integrate in progenitors.

slots.claim_sentence: Drosophila neuroblasts are a good model because they are identifiable and have known spatial and temporal factors.
slots.clarification_sentence: Neuroblasts are neural progenitors in fruit flies used to study how neurons develop.

slots.claim_sentence: The study tested if spatial and temporal factors act independently or sequentially in neuroblasts.

slots.clarification_sentence: NB5-6 and NB7-4 produce different types of neurons.

slots.claim_sentence: Hunchback bound to different targets in each neuroblast, ruling out the independent specification model.

slots.clarification_sentence: Open chromatin means DNA is accessible for binding.

slots.claim_sentence: The spatial factor Gsb/Pax3 is expressed in NB5-6 but not NB7-4 and binds DNA at open chromatin sites in NB5-6 only.
slots.clarification_sentence: Gsb binding correlates with open chromatin only in NB5-6.

slots.claim_sentence: Early spatial factors like Gsb create neuroblast-specific open chromatin, allowing temporal factors to bind specific genes.
slots.clarification_sentence: This process leads to different neurons being made in each neuroblast lineage.

slots.claim_sentence: P2X receptors are ion channels that open a pore in response to extracellular ATP.
slots.clarification_sentence: This pore allows ions to pass through the cell membrane and start signals inside the cell.

slots.claim_sentence: The mechanism of pore opening in P2X receptors is still controversial.
slots.clarification_sentence: More data are needed to understand how the full receptor opens in its natural membrane environment.

slots.claim_sentence: This study used photo-switchable cross-linkers as molecular tweezers to monitor distances in the P2X2 receptor's transmembrane domain.

slots.claim_sentence: Experimental constraints combined with computational studies created high-resolution models of the P2X2 channel in open and closed states.

slots.clarification_sentence: This shows the open channel is more compact than previously thought.

slots.claim_sentence: The inner and outer ends of adjacent pore-lining helices come closer during opening by a hinge-bending motion.
slots.clarification_sentence: This bending likely occurs at a critical gating hinge in the helices.

slots.claim_sentence: These results provide new insight into the gating mechanism of P2X receptors.
slots.clarification_sentence: The method used is versatile and can be applied to study other membrane proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: Latent Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) infection is linked to several human cancers.
slots.clarification_sentence: EBV was the first human tumor virus discovered and affects B cells and epithelial cells.

slots.claim_sentence: EBV produces viral oncogenes that promote cell growth and block apoptosis.
slots.clarification_sentence: Apoptosis is a process where cells self-destruct to prevent uncontrolled growth.

slots.claim_sentence: The EBV protein LMP1 activates NFκB and is critical for survival of immortalized B cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: LMP1 keeps infected B cells alive by continuously triggering a survival pathway called NFκB.

slots.claim_sentence: Early after infection, EBV causes rapid B cell growth with low LMP1 and little apoptosis.
slots.clarification_sentence: This shows that infected cells survive even when LMP1 levels are low.

slots.claim_sentence: The study aimed to find how B cells survive early without LMP1 or NFκB activity.
Researchers used BH3 profiling to study mitochondrial control of apoptosis in B cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: BH3 profiling tests which proteins help cells avoid death by stressing mitochondria.

slots.claim_sentence: EBV changes B cell survival by controlling MCL-1 location and BFL-1 production via EBNA3A.
slots.clarification_sentence: The viral protein EBNA3A directs these changes unique to infected cells.

slots.claim_sentence: This study reveals a new role for EBNA3A in blocking apoptosis in EBV-infected B cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding helps explain how EBV may promote lymphoma development.

slots.claim_sentence: Heterostyly is a floral adaptation that promotes outbreeding in plants.
slots.clarification_sentence: This adaptation helps flowers avoid self-fertilization by having different reproductive organ arrangements.

slots.claim_sentence: In primroses, heterostyly is controlled by the S-locus supergene.
slots.clarification_sentence: The S-locus controls how reproductive organs are arranged and prevents self-pollination between flower types.

slots.claim_sentence: The CYP734A50 gene in primroses determines the style-length dimorphism.
slots.clarification_sentence: This gene encodes an enzyme that breaks down brassinosteroids, hormones that affect growth.

slots.claim_sentence: CYP734A50 is only present on the short-styled S-morph haplotype.
slots.clarification_sentence: It is specifically active in S-morph styles, and losing it causes long styles to develop.

slots.claim_sentence: The CYP734A50 gene arose from a duplication unique to the Primulaceae family.
slots.clarification_sentence: This gene has evolved faster than related genes since that duplication.

slots.claim_sentence: These results explain how primroses develop different style lengths.
slots.clarification_sentence: They also help us understand the evolution of the S-locus as a complex plant supergene.

slots.claim_sentence: The two centrioles in quiescent cells differ in age, shape, and function.
slots.clarification_sentence: These centrioles form part of the centrosome, which organizes microtubules.

slots.claim_sentence: How these differences form and persist during quiescence is unknown.
slots.clarification_sentence: The mechanisms establishing and maintaining these properties remain unclear.

slots.claim_sentence: Cep120, a protein linked to ciliopathies, inhibits processes at daughter centrioles.
slots.clarification_sentence: Cep120 is found specifically at the daughter centriole in cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Removing Cep120 causes accumulation of pericentriolar material components.

slots.claim_sentence: Higher levels of pericentriolar material increase microtubule-nucleation at the centrosome.
slots.clarification_sentence: The centrosome's microtubule-organizing activity rises with more PCM.

slots.claim_sentence: Loss of Cep120 disrupts protein trafficking and causes defective cilia assembly and signaling.
slots.clarification_sentence: This includes abnormal dynein-dependent movement and dispersal of centriolar satellites.

slots.claim_sentence: Cep120 maintains centrosome balance by preventing early daughter centriole maturation.
slots.clarification_sentence: Cep120 mainly controls the PCM stage of daughter centriole maturation.

slots.claim_sentence: This mechanism reveals a new molecular defect linked to ciliopathies like Jeune and Joubert syndromes.

slots.clarification_sentence: Forensic entomology uses insect development stages to estimate PMI.

slots.claim_sentence: Microbes offer a novel method to estimate PMI that avoids many limitations of current techniques.
slots.clarification_sentence: Microbial communities are present before death and can be measured using DNA sequencing.

slots.claim_sentence: Postmortem microbial community changes are dramatic, measurable, and repeatable in a mouse model.
slots.clarification_sentence: These changes allow PMI to be estimated within about 3 days over a 48-day period. The mouse model used destructive sampling of both surface and interior tissues.

slots.claim_sentence: The study details bacterial and microbial eukaryotic ecology in decomposing corpses.
slots.clarification_sentence: Microbial community data could be developed into a forensic tool for estimating PMI.

slots.claim_sentence: More than 90% of AMPARs labeled with dyes or sQDs diffused in confined nanodomains within PSDs.
slots.clarification_sentence: These nanodomains remained stable for 15 minutes or longer.

slots.claim_sentence: Less than 10% of sQD-labeled AMPARs were extrasynaptic and highly mobile.
slots.clarification_sentence: This contrasts with previous assumptions about a large extrasynaptic pool.

slots.claim_sentence: In contrast, 5–10% of bQD-labeled AMPARs were in PSDs and 90–95% were extrasynaptic.
slots.clarification_sentence: This result matched previous observations using large probes.

slots.claim_sentence: AMPARs rapidly enter stable nanodomains in PSDs lasting over 15 minutes.
slots.clarification_sentence: AMPARs do not accumulate in extrasynaptic membranes as previously thought.

slots.claim_sentence: The earliest response of central neurons to hypoxia is an increase in voltage-gated sodium current (INa).
slots.clarification_sentence: The mechanism behind this increase was previously unknown.

slots.claim_sentence: Hypoxia activates the Small Ubiquitin-like Modifier (SUMO) pathway in rat cerebellar granule neurons (CGN).
slots.clarification_sentence: The SUMO pathway modifies proteins by attaching SUMO molecules.

slots.claim_sentence: SUMOylation of NaV1.2 channels increases the sodium current (INa).
slots.clarification_sentence: SUMOylation causes NaV1.2 channels to open more readily.

slots.claim_sentence: Mutation of NaV1.2 at Lys38 or applying a deSUMOylating enzyme prevents both SUMOylation and the increase in INa.
slots.clarification_sentence: This shows that Lys38 and SUMOylation are essential for the sodium current increase.

slots.claim_sentence: Within 40 seconds, hypoxia causes SUMO1 to link to NaV1.2 channels, shifting their activation voltage.
slots.clarification_sentence: This shift makes depolarizing steps evoke larger sodium currents.

slots.claim_sentence: The SUMO pathway and NaV1.2 channels are potential targets for neuroprotective interventions.
slots.clarification_sentence: Increased INa contributes to brain damage during hypoxia.

slots.claim_sentence: Vector-borne disease transmission peaks at intermediate temperatures and declines at high and low temperatures.
slots.clarification_sentence: Mosquito survival and performance depend on environmental temperature.

slots.claim_sentence: The thermal optima and limits for most vector-borne pathogens are currently unknown.
Researchers built a mechanistic model for the thermal response of Ross River virus, a mosquito-borne pathogen in Australia and the Pacific Islands.
slots.clarification_sentence: Ross River virus may also emerge in other parts of the world.

slots.claim_sentence: Ross River virus transmission peaks at a moderate temperature of 26.4°C.
slots.clarification_sentence: The optimal temperature is largely determined by adult mosquito lifespan.

slots.claim_sentence: Transmission declines to zero at thermal limits of 17.0°C and 31.5°C.
The model predicts year-round Ross River virus transmission in tropical areas and seasonal transmission in temperate areas.
slots.clarification_sentence: This pattern causes a nationwide seasonal peak in human cases.

slots.claim_sentence: Climate warming will likely increase transmission in temperate areas where most Australians live.
slots.clarification_sentence: Warming will likely decrease transmission in tropical areas near the thermal optimum.

slots.claim_sentence: These results show the importance of nonlinear models to predict temperature effects on disease and climate change responses.

slots.claim_sentence: The behavioral correlates of motor cortical beta oscillations are not fully understood.
Researchers recorded multi-scale neural activity from motor cortex in three macaques using a neurofeedback task.
slots.clarification_sentence: Multi-scale neural activity captures brain signals from single neurons to larger brain waves.

slots.claim_sentence: The macaques volitionally controlled their beta oscillatory power to a set level before making an arm reach.
slots.clarification_sentence: Volitionally means the monkeys consciously changed their brain wave power.

slots.claim_sentence: Reaches after a reduction in beta power had significantly faster movement onset times than after an increase.
slots.clarification_sentence: Movement onset time is the delay between a cue and the start of movement.

slots.claim_sentence: Population neural activity shifted farther from a movement onset state during both neurofeedback-induced and natural beta oscillations.
slots.clarification_sentence: A movement onset state is the neural pattern just before movement begins.

slots.claim_sentence: This finding shows a population neural basis for slowed movement onset after beta oscillatory activity.
slots.clarification_sentence: A population neural basis means groups of neurons explain the slower movement start.

slots.claim_sentence: TRAF2 is part of TNF superfamily signalling complexes and regulates immune cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: It plays an essential role in immune cell regulation and homeostasis.

slots.claim_sentence: TRAF2 deficient mice die around birth, limiting study of adult tissues.
slots.clarification_sentence: This early lethality prevents analysis of TRAF2 functions in adult epithelial cells.

slots.claim_sentence: The role of the TRAF2 RING domain is controversial.
Some claim TRAF2 RING cannot act as an E3 ligase without sphingosine-1-phosphate.
slots.clarification_sentence: Sphingosine-1-phosphate is made by sphingosine kinase 1 and may act as a co-factor.

slots.claim_sentence: Deleting Traf2 in keratinocytes disrupted TNF signalling and caused psoriasis-like skin inflammation.
slots.clarification_sentence: Sphk1 deficiency did not cause these effects in skin cells.

slots.claim_sentence: The inflammation involved TNF, cell death, non-canonical NF-κB, and the adaptive immune system.
slots.clarification_sentence: This model may be relevant for studying psoriasis.

slots.claim_sentence: TRAF2 has tissue-specific functions that do not overlap with those of Sphk1.

slots.claim_sentence: There is currently no biomarker that can quantify the action of glucocorticoids.
slots.clarification_sentence: Current methods to monitor glucocorticoid action and tailor treatment are inadequate.

slots.claim_sentence: The study aimed to identify and validate circulating biomarkers of glucocorticoid action.
The study included 10 subjects with primary adrenal insufficiency, studied during glucocorticoid exposure and withdrawal.
slots.clarification_sentence: Primary adrenal insufficiency means these patients do not produce their own glucocorticoids.

slots.claim_sentence: The study compared gene activity, microRNAs, and metabolites using integrated multi-omic analysis.
slots.clarification_sentence: Multi-omic analysis combines data from blood cells, fat tissue, plasma, and serum.

slots.claim_sentence: A gene activity profile from two tissues and a multi-omic cluster predicted glucocorticoid exposure.
slots.clarification_sentence: The gene profile included nine genes co-regulated in blood and fat tissue.

slots.claim_sentence: A microRNA called miR-122-5p correlated with genes and metabolites regulated by glucocorticoids.
slots.clarification_sentence: MicroRNAs are small molecules that control gene activity.

slots.claim_sentence: The microRNA miR-122-5p was replicated in independent studies with varying glucocorticoid exposure.
These results provide a basis to discover biomarkers that measure glucocorticoid effects.
slots.clarification_sentence: Such biomarkers could help tailor therapy and understand diseases linked to abnormal glucocorticoid levels.

slots.claim_sentence: Dendritic cells take up antigens and route them inside the cell using C-type lectin receptors.
slots.clarification_sentence: These receptors recognize specific sugar structures called glycans on the antigens.

slots.claim_sentence: Adding the sugar LewisX to Ovalbumin redirects it to the receptor MGL1 on dendritic cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: MGL1 is expressed on several dendritic cell types in lymphoid and skin tissues.

slots.claim_sentence: LewisX-modified Ovalbumin promotes Th1 development of CD4+ T cells and boosts CD8+ T cell activation.
LewisX modification lowers the needed Ovalbumin dose for cross-presentation by 100-fold and removes the need for TLR signals.
slots.clarification_sentence: Native Ovalbumin requires a high dose and TLR stimuli for cross-presentation.

slots.claim_sentence: The enhanced T cell activation by Ovalbumin-LewisX depends on MGL1, shown by fewer CD8+ T cells in MGL1-deficient mice.
MGL1-driven cross-presentation of Ovalbumin-LewisX does not need TAP-transporters or Cathepsin-S.
slots.clarification_sentence: This cross-presentation occurs even after long storage in Rab11+LAMP1+ compartments inside cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Controlled addition of sugars to antigens can change their routing and immune response strength.
slots.clarification_sentence: This approach should be considered to improve current vaccination methods.

slots.claim_sentence: Burkholderia thailandensis uses acyl-homoserine lactone quorum sensing systems to regulate hundreds of genes.
slots.clarification_sentence: These quorum sensing systems use chemical signals to coordinate gene expression.

slots.claim_sentence: Quorum sensing activates cell-cell contact-dependent type VI secretion toxin-immunity systems in B. thailandensis.
slots.clarification_sentence: These systems include toxins and proteins that protect against them.

slots.claim_sentence: Type VI secretion is required to limit quorum sensing mutant growth in colony cocultures.
slots.clarification_sentence: The mutants studied lack the BtaR1 quorum-sensing signal receptor.

slots.claim_sentence: The BtaR1 mutant outcompetes its parent in broth coculture where cell contact is limited.
slots.clarification_sentence: Quorum sensing gene activation has a metabolic cost for the parent bacteria.

slots.claim_sentence: Quorum sensing activates B. thailandensis T6SS-1 to inhibit growth of quorum-sensing mutants.
slots.clarification_sentence: This system polices and constrains mutants within the bacterial population.

slots.claim_sentence: This work reveals a novel role for Type VI secretion systems in controlling mutants within the same species.
slots.clarification_sentence: The system acts through cell contact to control mutant growth.

slots.claim_sentence: Long-range coupling within prefrontal-hippocampal networks emerges early in life.
slots.clarification_sentence: This coupling supports cognitive performance like memory and attention.

slots.claim_sentence: The cellular substrate of early interactions between hippocampal theta bursts and neonatal prefrontal oscillations is unresolved.
slots.clarification_sentence: Hippocampal theta bursts are bursts of electrical activity thought to drive prefrontal oscillations in newborns.

slots.claim_sentence: The study used optogenetic manipulation of glutamatergic neurons in CA1 of dorsal or intermediate/ventral hippocampus at neonatal age.
slots.clarification_sentence: Optogenetics allows control of specific neurons using light.

slots.claim_sentence: The prefrontal cortex mainly couples with intermediate/ventral hippocampus by phase-locking of neuronal firing.
slots.clarification_sentence: This coupling occurs despite stronger theta and ripple power in dorsal hippocampus.

slots.claim_sentence: Activating pyramidal neurons in intermediate/ventral CA1 at theta frequencies boosts prefrontal oscillations.
slots.clarification_sentence: Activating dorsal CA1 neurons does not affect prefrontal activity.

slots.claim_sentence: These data causally elucidate the cellular origin of long-range coupling in the developing brain.
slots.clarification_sentence: These findings give insights into the mechanisms underlying the early generation of activity patterns.

slots.claim_sentence: piRNAs regulate transposons and other germline genes.
slots.clarification_sentence: piRNAs are small RNA molecules that silence harmful genetic elements in reproductive cells.

slots.claim_sentence: In C. elegans, the mutator complex makes siRNAs to control piRNA target genes.
slots.clarification_sentence: The mutator complex uses an RNA-dependent RNA polymerase to produce many siRNAs.

slots.claim_sentence: The steps linking piRNA recognition to siRNA amplification were unknown.
slots.clarification_sentence: How mRNAs move from the piRNA system to the mutator complex was unclear.

slots.claim_sentence: The Tudor domain protein SIMR-1 acts after piRNA production and before siRNA biogenesis.
slots.clarification_sentence: SIMR-1 connects the initial piRNA activity to siRNA production by the mutator complex.

slots.claim_sentence: SIMR-1 localizes to foci near P granules and Mutator foci in the cell.
slots.clarification_sentence: P granules and Mutator foci are compartments for piRNA recognition and siRNA amplification.

slots.claim_sentence: Multiple perinuclear condensates organize the piRNA pathway and promote mRNA regulation.
slots.clarification_sentence: These compartments work together to help the mutator complex control gene silencing.

slots.claim_sentence: SIMR-1 forms germline foci that are distinct from P granules and Mutator foci.

slots.claim_sentence: Epsin is an evolutionarily conserved protein that helps in clathrin-mediated endocytosis.
slots.clarification_sentence: Its most critical functions in clathrin coat dynamics are not fully understood.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers generated embryonic fibroblasts from mice lacking all three epsin proteins.
slots.clarification_sentence: These cells are called conditional epsin triple knockout cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Epsin triple knockout cells showed a strong defect in cell division.
slots.clarification_sentence: This defect extended previous observations in cells lacking two epsins.

slots.claim_sentence: These cells also had a severe impairment in clathrin-mediated endocytosis.
slots.clarification_sentence: This caused an accumulation of early and U-shaped clathrin-coated pits.

slots.claim_sentence: The endocytosis defect was linked to a disrupted connection between the clathrin coat and actin cytoskeleton.
slots.clarification_sentence: This disruption was confirmed by experiments outside living cells.

slots.claim_sentence: A key function of epsin is to help generate force for invagination and fission of clathrin-coated pits.
slots.clarification_sentence: Epsin also interacts weakly with SNARE proteins involved in vesicle targeting.

slots.claim_sentence: Interactions between all three pigment cell types form the stripe pattern in adult zebrafish.
slots.clarification_sentence: These pigment cells include melanophores, xanthophores, and iridophores.

slots.claim_sentence: Mutations in the leopard (leo) gene cause spotted patterns in zebrafish.
slots.clarification_sentence: The leo gene encodes Connexin 41.8 (Cx41.8), a gap junction subunit.

slots.claim_sentence: A dominant allele, leotK3, causes a complete loss of the stripe pattern in zebrafish.
slots.clarification_sentence: This allele acts dominantly to disrupt gap junction function.

slots.claim_sentence: A genetic screen identified Connexin 39.4 (Cx39.4), called luchs, as another gap junction component.
slots.clarification_sentence: The dominant negative effect in leotK3 abolishes both leo and luchs functions.

slots.claim_sentence: Loss-of-function alleles of luchs disrupt stripe formation in zebrafish bodies but not in fins.
Cx41.8 (leo) and Cx39.4 (luchs) form heteromeric gap junctions in xanthophores and melanophores.
slots.clarification_sentence: These connexins are not required in iridophores for pattern formation.

slots.claim_sentence: These gap junctions promote homotypic interactions between melanophores and xanthophores.
slots.clarification_sentence: These interactions help instruct the patterning of iridophores.

slots.claim_sentence: The global malaria burden has decreased over the last decade.
slots.clarification_sentence: Many nations are now trying to eliminate malaria.

slots.claim_sentence: Asymptomatic malaria infections are not normally diagnosed or treated.
slots.clarification_sentence: These infections pose a major hurdle for elimination efforts.

slots.claim_sentence: Mass drug administration (MDA) can address asymptomatic infections.
slots.clarification_sentence: MDA success depends on adequate population participation.

slots.claim_sentence: This study analyzed malaria episodes and asymptomatic infections in four Myanmar villages undergoing MDA.
slots.clarification_sentence: The villages are located in Kayin State near the Myanmar-Thailand border.

slots.claim_sentence: People in neighborhoods with low MDA adherence had 2.85 times higher odds of malaria episodes post-MDA.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was true regardless of individual participation, indicating a herd effect.

slots.claim_sentence: This study is the first to document a herd effect from MDA for Plasmodium falciparum malaria.
slots.clarification_sentence: The herd effect protects even those who do not take the drugs.

slots.claim_sentence: High mosquito biting rates, living with someone with malaria, or having asymptomatic infection predict clinical episodes.
slots.clarification_sentence: Living in the same house with an infected person increases risk.

slots.claim_sentence: Spatial clustering of non-adherence to MDA may hinder malaria elimination.
slots.clarification_sentence: This occurs even in villages with high overall MDA participation.

slots.claim_sentence: The developing heart and lung engage in extensive crosstalk for proper formation and maturation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This crosstalk is critical for their morphogenesis during embryonic development.

slots.claim_sentence: There is a lack of models to study heart and lung interaction during human embryogenesis.
slots.clarification_sentence: Existing models do not fully capture the mutual interaction in human development.

slots.claim_sentence: The study developed a stepwise method to induce cardiac and lung epithelial cells from hiPSCs simultaneously.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method uses timed control of WNT and nodal signaling without added growth factors.

slots.claim_sentence: Using 3D suspension culture, the researchers created concentric cardio-pulmonary micro-Tissues (μTs).
slots.clarification_sentence: Lung cell maturation sped up when heart cells were present in these micro-Tissues.

slots.claim_sentence: Removing the WNT agonist caused heart and lung parts in each μT to separate.
slots.clarification_sentence: This separation happened alongside the start of heart cell contraction.

slots.claim_sentence: The multilineage differentiation model offers a system to study heart-lung interaction and tissue boundary formation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This system is experimentally tractable for human embryonic development research.

slots.claim_sentence: The AMPK/Snf1/SnRK1 kinases regulate metabolism during low energy in animals, yeast, and plants.
slots.clarification_sentence: These kinases activate under energy starvation to help organisms survive stress.

slots.claim_sentence: These kinases act by changing enzyme activity and reprogramming gene expression.
slots.clarification_sentence: They modulate key metabolic enzymes and perform extensive transcriptional reprogramming.

slots.claim_sentence: The gene expression control by these kinases is poorly known in animals and unknown in plants.
slots.clarification_sentence: The transcription factors that mediate this response in plants were not identified before.

slots.claim_sentence: The Arabidopsis transcription factor bZIP63 is a key regulator and direct target of SnRK1.
slots.clarification_sentence: bZIP63 is the first plant transcription factor found to be directly controlled by SnRK1.

slots.claim_sentence: SnRK1 adds phosphate groups to bZIP63, changing its dimerization preference.
slots.clarification_sentence: This change affects which genes bZIP63 controls and alters primary metabolism.

slots.claim_sentence: Plants lacking bZIP63 show starvation symptoms that normal bZIP63 can fix.
slots.clarification_sentence: Mutated bZIP63 that cannot be phosphorylated by SnRK1 fails to restore normal function.
They trigger metabolic reprogramming to slow energy use and activate alternative energy pathways.

slots.claim_sentence: Ternatin is a natural product that kills cells and blocks fat cell formation.
slots.clarification_sentence: The molecular way ternatin works was previously unknown.

slots.claim_sentence: New synthetic ternatin variants kill cancer cells with up to 500-fold greater potency.
slots.clarification_sentence: These variants need much lower doses to kill cancer cells than ternatin itself.

slots.claim_sentence: A ternatin photo-affinity probe identified the eEF1A ternary complex as a specific target.
slots.clarification_sentence: This complex includes eEF1A, GTP, and aminoacyl-tRNA and is involved in protein production.

slots.claim_sentence: Unrelated natural products didemnin and cytotrienin competitively bind the same eEF1A complex.
Mutations in domain III of eEF1A stop ternatin binding and cause resistance to its effects.
slots.clarification_sentence: These mutations prevent ternatin from killing cells by blocking its binding site.

slots.claim_sentence: A nearby hydrophobic surface on eEF1A acts as a functional hot spot for modulation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This area is important for how ternatin and similar molecules affect eEF1A.

slots.claim_sentence: The eEF1A ternary complex is a common target for cytotoxic natural products.
slots.clarification_sentence: Different natural compounds have evolved to bind this shared site on eEF1A.

slots.claim_sentence: Mutations in the inositol 5-phosphatase OCRL cause Lowe syndrome and Dent's disease.
slots.clarification_sentence: OCRL is a protein that modifies a membrane lipid.

slots.claim_sentence: OCRL loss in Lowe syndrome patient fibroblasts causes an endocytic defect.
slots.clarification_sentence: Endocytosis is a process where cells take in molecules by forming vesicles.

slots.claim_sentence: Lowe syndrome patient cells accumulate clathrin-coated vesicles and U-shaped clathrin-coated pits.
slots.clarification_sentence: Clathrin forms a coat around vesicles during endocytosis.

slots.claim_sentence: Vesicles that fail to lose their coat create most actin comets in patient cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: Actin comets are structures that help move vesicles inside cells.

slots.claim_sentence: SNX9 binds OCRL directly and stays on vesicles that fail to lose their coat.
slots.clarification_sentence: SNX9 is an adaptor that links coated pits to actin polymerization.

slots.claim_sentence: OCRL acts as an uncoating factor in clathrin-mediated endocytosis.
slots.clarification_sentence: An uncoating factor removes the clathrin coat from vesicles.

slots.claim_sentence: Defects in clathrin-mediated endocytosis likely contribute to pathology in patients with OCRL mutations.
slots.clarification_sentence: OCRL facilitates recycling of endocytic factors needed for normal endocytosis.

slots.clarification_sentence: Finding effective Wnt inhibitors for cancer treatment remains challenging.

slots.clarification_sentence: Better understanding of this pathway could lead to new treatment strategies.

slots.claim_sentence: Phosphorylation of GSK3βY216 enables GSK3β to recruit β-TrCP.

slots.claim_sentence: Inhibiting FAK and PYK2 reduces adenoma formation in APCmin/+ mice.

slots.claim_sentence: The transcription factor RpaA is the master regulator of circadian transcription in cyanobacteria.
slots.clarification_sentence: RpaA controls when many genes are turned on or off following a daily rhythm.

slots.claim_sentence: Deleting rpaA makes cyanobacteria unable to survive in cycling light and dark conditions.
slots.clarification_sentence: The rpaA- strain survives in constant light but dies when light and dark alternate.

slots.claim_sentence: AAA+ chaperones use ATP to unfold proteins by threading them through a central pore.
slots.clarification_sentence: This ATP-fueled unfolding is essential for protein quality control.

slots.claim_sentence: The unfolding activity of AAA+ chaperones can be harmful and needs tight repression and specific activation.
slots.clarification_sentence: Tight control prevents damage from unwanted protein degradation.

slots.claim_sentence: The AAA+ chaperone ClpC and peptidase ClpP form a bacterial protease essential for virulence and stress resistance.
Researchers used cryo-EM to determine ClpC structures with and without the activator MecA.
slots.clarification_sentence: This helped to understand how ClpC is kept inactive in its ground state.

slots.claim_sentence: In its inactive state, ClpC forms two-helical assemblies linked by head-to-head contacts between coiled-coil middle domains.
MecA activates ClpC by binding to middle domain sites and converting it into an active planar ring.
Mutations in ClpC middle domains cause constant activation and severe toxicity to cells.
Coiled-coil middle domains form an unexpected regulatory system that tightly controls AAA+ chaperone activity.

slots.claim_sentence: The GABAergic neurons of the substantia nigra pars reticulata provide tonic inhibition to other brain areas.
slots.clarification_sentence: These neurons are a main output of the basal ganglia, a brain region involved in movement control.

slots.claim_sentence: A depolarizing leak current supports the spontaneous firing of SNr neurons, but its molecular basis is unclear.
slots.clarification_sentence: This leak current is a steady flow of ions that keeps neurons active without external input.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used single-cell RNA sequencing to study gene expression in individual mouse SNr neurons.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method identifies which genes are active in each neuron, revealing possible ion channels involved.

slots.claim_sentence: SNr neurons express the sodium leak channel NALCN, and neurons without NALCN fire less spontaneously.
slots.clarification_sentence: NALCN allows sodium ions to enter cells, helping maintain the depolarizing current for firing.

slots.claim_sentence: NALCN helps adjust SNr neuron activity in response to changes in glycolysis and muscarinic acetylcholine receptor activation.
slots.clarification_sentence: Glycolysis is a process that produces energy, and muscarinic receptors respond to chemical signals from other neurons.

slots.claim_sentence: Disruption of NALCN may impair the basal ganglia circuit and cause severe motor deficits in humans with NALCN mutations.
slots.clarification_sentence: The basal ganglia circuit controls movement, so its impairment can lead to motor disorders.

slots.claim_sentence: Tuberculous meningitis causes high mortality linked to excessive inflammation.
Adjunctive anti-inflammatory corticosteroids reduce mortality by only 30%.
slots.clarification_sentence: This shows inflammation causes only some deaths in tuberculous meningitis.

slots.claim_sentence: In Vietnam, corticosteroids helped patients with a C/T variant in the LTA4H gene.
slots.clarification_sentence: The LTA4H gene controls inflammation through an enzyme that regulates inflammatory eicosanoids.

slots.claim_sentence: Patients with the LTA4H TT genotype had increased survival and inflammation.
slots.clarification_sentence: The TT genotype causes higher LTA4H expression and hyper-inflammatory responses.

slots.claim_sentence: An Indonesia study did not find a survival benefit for the LTA4H TT genotype.
slots.clarification_sentence: The Indonesia study had more severe patients with higher early mortality.

slots.claim_sentence: Bayesian analysis showed the LTA4H TT genotype improves survival early and long-term in both populations.
The survival benefit of the LTA4H TT genotype is lost in the most severe cases with high early mortality.
Combining LTA4H genotyping with disease severity may guide glucocorticoid therapy to patients who benefit most.

slots.claim_sentence: The roles of chance, contingency, and necessity in evolution remain unresolved.

slots.clarification_sentence: They studied proteins from the BCL-2 family to observe changes in binding specificity seen in animal evolution.

slots.claim_sentence: Contingency over long times erased necessity and outweighed chance in causing sequence changes.
slots.clarification_sentence: Proteins from distant ancestors showed almost no shared mutations despite identical selection pressures.

slots.claim_sentence: Chance occurred because many mutation sets could change specificity at any time.
slots.clarification_sentence: Contingency happened because past substitutions altered which mutation sets were possible later.

slots.claim_sentence: Variation patterns in BCL-2 sequences are unique products of unpredictable historical events.
slots.clarification_sentence: Sequence–structure–function associations result from contingent constraints imposed or removed by chance during history.

slots.claim_sentence: Early animal development involves rapid cell divisions that reduce cell size.
slots.clarification_sentence: The mitotic spindle must adjust its size to match these smaller cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used cytoplasmic extracts from Xenopus laevis embryos at stages 3 and 8.
slots.clarification_sentence: Stage 3 embryos have 4 cells of 37 micrometers, and stage 8 embryos have about 4000 cells of 18 micrometers.

slots.claim_sentence: The protein kif2a drives spindle scaling by destabilizing microtubules.
slots.clarification_sentence: Importin α inhibits kif2a in stage 3 but moves to membranes in stage 8, activating kif2a.
Importin α redistributes from cytoplasm to membranes between stages 3 and 8.

slots.claim_sentence: Changing spindle size impaired spindle orientation during metaphase in embryos.
slots.clarification_sentence: Despite this, chromosome segregation remained strong and unaffected.

slots.claim_sentence: Spindle size in Xenopus development is linked to cell size by a ratiometric mechanism.
slots.clarification_sentence: This mechanism controls microtubule destabilization to scale the spindle properly.

slots.claim_sentence: HIV-1 Gag selects and packages a dimeric, unspliced viral RNA despite excess human RNAs.
slots.clarification_sentence: The viral RNA is specifically chosen over abundant cellular RNAs.

slots.claim_sentence: Gag assembles on the plasma membrane and enriches viral RNA over cellular RNAs by an unknown mechanism.
slots.clarification_sentence: The viral genome is enriched during Gag assembly on the membrane.

slots.claim_sentence: A minimal system with purified RNAs, recombinant Gag, and giant unilamellar vesicles replicated selective packaging of the viral 5’ untranslated region.
slots.clarification_sentence: This system allowed study of RNA packaging in the presence of excess competitor RNA.

slots.claim_sentence: Mutations in Gag’s CA-CTD domain that affect self-assembly abolished RNA selectivity.
slots.clarification_sentence: These mutations subtly disrupt Gag clustering on membranes without greatly reducing nonspecific RNA binding.

slots.claim_sentence: tRNA suppresses Gag membrane binding less when Gag has already bound viral RNA.
slots.clarification_sentence: Binding viral RNA helps Gag overcome tRNA inhibition of membrane association.

slots.claim_sentence: Gag’s ability to selectively package viral RNA and its self-assembly on membranes are interdependent.

slots.claim_sentence: The role of RNA 3′-end processing in regulatory variation is largely unknown.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is partly because functional elements in 3′ untranslated regions are hard to identify.

slots.claim_sentence: The study surveyed transcript ends in lymphoblastoid cells from genetically distinct human individuals.
slots.clarification_sentence: These immune cells came from different people to capture genetic diversity.

slots.claim_sentence: Transcript end positions were not random but flanked 3′ regulatory elements, including miRNA sites.
slots.clarification_sentence: These positions are near sequences that control gene expression.

slots.claim_sentence: Polymorphisms in polyadenylation signals and other 3′ motifs predicted gene expression levels.
slots.clarification_sentence: The usage of these RNA end forms varied across human individuals.

slots.claim_sentence: Single-gene experiments confirmed that polyadenylation variants affect steady-state gene expression.
slots.clarification_sentence: These experiments also validated 3′ cis-regulatory elements controlling RNA length forms.

slots.claim_sentence: Natural variation in RNA 3′-end processing affected the immune regulator IRF5's response to antigen stimulation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This shows genetic differences can change gene regulation during immune responses.

slots.claim_sentence: Two mechanisms drive genetics of 3′-end variation: distinct processing signals and 3′ sequence elements.
slots.clarification_sentence: These mechanisms determine the fate of RNA transcripts and their expression levels.

slots.claim_sentence: Integrating observed 3′-end positions with inferred regulatory motifs is key to interpreting human genome variation.

slots.claim_sentence: The study explores a framework to model allosteric multisite phosphorylation proteins using a single auxiliary variable.
slots.clarification_sentence: This approach, called modified fraction modeling, simplifies complex systems by tracking one variable.

slots.claim_sentence: The simplified model can closely replicate steady state behavior of detailed multisite systems.
slots.clarification_sentence: It matches complex models like the Monod-Wyman-Changeux allosteric model and rule-based models.

slots.claim_sentence: Optimal ultrasensitivity occurs when activation by individual sites is concerted and redundant.
slots.clarification_sentence: Multiple phosphorylations are needed, but not all sites must be modified for full activation.

slots.claim_sentence: This reduction makes the framework useful for modeling biochemical systems with multiple multisite proteins.
slots.clarification_sentence: The simplification avoids the complexity of many variables in detailed multisite models.

slots.claim_sentence: The framework is applied to analyze a checkpoint signaling pathway in budding yeast.
slots.clarification_sentence: This pathway is proposed to measure cell growth by signals from plasma membrane growth sites.

slots.claim_sentence: The known components of this pathway can form a robust hysteretic switch.
slots.clarification_sentence: The switch maintains a high output even if the input signal decreases after activation.

slots.claim_sentence: The system uses a signal proportional to bud growth, a reader mechanism, and an all-or-none response.
slots.clarification_sentence: The response triggers only when the signal reaches a threshold showing sufficient growth.

slots.claim_sentence: Inflammation is necessary for promoting, sustaining, and tuning CD8+ T cell responses.
slots.clarification_sentence: CD8+ T cells are critical for immune defense against infections.

slots.claim_sentence: The transcription factor IRF-5 mainly induces the inflammatory response after Leishmania donovani infection.
IRF-5 activates genes encoding key pro-inflammatory cytokines like IL-6 and TNF.
The inflammatory response induced by IRF-5 limits CD8+ T cell expansion and induces HIF-1α in dendritic cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: HIF-1α expression is upregulated only in dendritic cells from infected IRF-5-sufficient mice.

slots.claim_sentence: Removing HIF-1α in CD11c+ cells increases short-lived effector cells, CD8+ T cell expansion, and IL-12 expression by splenic dendritic cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: CD11c+ cells are a type of dendritic cell important for immune responses.

slots.claim_sentence: Mice lacking HIF-1α in CD11c+ cells have a significantly lower splenic parasite burden.
slots.clarification_sentence: This shows that HIF-1α induction may help Leishmania parasites evade the immune system and cause persistent infections.

slots.claim_sentence: Long-term delivery of potent broadly-neutralizing antibodies can prevent HIV-1 infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: AAV vectors deliver antibodies that can persist for long periods.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used AAV vector intramuscularly to deliver anti-SIV monoclonal antibodies in IgG1 form to rhesus monkeys.
slots.clarification_sentence: Rhesus monkeys served as the animal model for testing this delivery method.

slots.claim_sentence: Persisting levels of delivered antibody reached as high as 270 micrograms per milliliter in some monkeys.
Host antibody responses occurred in 9 of 12 monkeys and limited antibody concentrations.
slots.clarification_sentence: These immune responses reduced the amount of delivered antibody that could be maintained.

slots.claim_sentence: Six monkeys given AAV-5L7 IgG1 antibodies showed protection against SIVmac239 despite no detectable neutralizing activity.
slots.clarification_sentence: SIVmac239 is a difficult-to-neutralize virus strain.

slots.claim_sentence: Protection included lower viral loads at peak and set point and delayed time to peak viral load.
One monkey with the highest antibody level resisted six successive intravenous SIVmac239 challenges.
slots.clarification_sentence: This monkey maintained about 270 micrograms per milliliter of antibody throughout challenges.

slots.claim_sentence: These results show promise for AAV-mediated antibody delivery to prevent HIV-1 infection in people.
Anti-antibody responses must be understood and overcome for this approach to succeed.
slots.clarification_sentence: Immune reactions against delivered antibodies could limit long-term effectiveness.

slots.claim_sentence: Toxoplasma is an obligate intracellular parasite that replicates within a parasitophorous vacuole in mammalian cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: The parasitophorous vacuole does not fuse with other host organelles.

slots.claim_sentence: This study examined how Toxoplasma exploits host lipid droplets, which are fat storage organelles.
Toxoplasma replication is reduced in host cells depleted of lipid droplets or impaired in fat breakdown.
slots.clarification_sentence: This shows that host lipid droplets and their fat-processing are important for parasite growth.

slots.claim_sentence: During infection, the parasitophorous vacuole is surrounded by host lipid droplets.
Toxoplasma accesses lipids from host lipid droplets and uses them in its own membranes and lipid stores.
Toxoplasma intercepts and internalizes host lipid droplets inside the vacuole to access their lipids.
slots.clarification_sentence: Some internalized droplets remain linked to Rab7 and are wrapped by a membrane network called IVN.

slots.claim_sentence: Mutant parasites with defective IVN formation show reduced lipid uptake from host lipid droplets.
slots.clarification_sentence: This indicates the IVN is important for lipid uptake by the parasite.

slots.claim_sentence: Parasites lacking an IVN-localized phospholipase A2 are less efficient at salvaging lipids from host droplets.
slots.clarification_sentence: This enzyme helps break down host lipid droplets to release lipids inside the vacuole.

slots.claim_sentence: This study highlights Toxoplasma’s reliance on host lipid droplets for its intracellular development.
slots.clarification_sentence: The parasite is capable of scavenging neutral lipids from these host droplets.

slots.claim_sentence: Fasciolosis is a disease caused by liver flukes Fasciola hepatica and Fasciola gigantica.
slots.clarification_sentence: Human infections of fasciolosis are increasing, making it an emerging zoonotic disease.

slots.claim_sentence: Resistance to triclabendazole, the main drug for fasciolosis, has been reported in several countries.
slots.clarification_sentence: This resistance creates a need for new chemical treatments and target molecules.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers screened forty flavonoid derivatives for inhibitors of Fasciola hepatica cysteine proteases.
slots.clarification_sentence: The enzymes FhCL3 and FhCL1 are key proteases active at different parasite stages.

slots.claim_sentence: Chalcones with phenyl and naphthyl groups were identified as good cathepsin L inhibitors.
slots.clarification_sentence: These chalcones interact with two binding sites in the enzymes' active cleft.

slots.claim_sentence: Compound C34 tightly bound juvenile-specific FhCL3 with an IC50 of 5.6 μM.
C34 is a slow-reversible inhibitor that binds the Cys-His catalytic dyad and key pocket residues of FhCL3.
slots.clarification_sentence: This binding controls the enzyme's substrate specificity.

slots.claim_sentence: C34 reduces juvenile fluke migration and motility, causing death in vitro without harming bovine cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: Reduced migration suggests impaired cathepsin L function in the parasite larvae.

slots.claim_sentence: These findings support developing novel agents to control fluke and other helminthic diseases.

slots.claim_sentence: The study used in vivo imaging to see how bipolar cells send signals to the inner retina.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers observed multiple bipolar cell synapses in live zebrafish using fluorescent proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: The size of the synaptic terminal is an intrinsic factor that shapes temporal filtering.
slots.clarification_sentence: The terminal volume influences how bipolar cells transmit diverse signals.

slots.claim_sentence: Smaller terminals produce faster and larger calcium signals that trigger vesicle release with higher initial gain and stronger adaptation.
Smaller terminals transmit higher stimulus frequencies more effectively than larger ones.
Modeling showed that differences in presynaptic terminal volume directly cause variations in response dynamics.
One neuron can send different temporal parts of the visual signal through terminals of different sizes and adaptation.

slots.claim_sentence: The impact of Nrf2 activation on HIV infection had not been tested before this study.
slots.clarification_sentence: Nrf2 is a transcription factor involved in cellular defense.

slots.clarification_sentence: SFN is a compound produced when these vegetables are damaged.

slots.claim_sentence: SFN blocks HIV infection in primary macrophages but not in primary T cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: Macrophages and T cells are types of immune cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Lowering Nrf2 levels in macrophages increased HIV infection and reduced SFN's anti-viral effect.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was done using siRNA to reduce Nrf2 in the cells.

slots.claim_sentence: SFN's anti-viral activity works by activating Nrf2 in macrophages.
slots.clarification_sentence: Nrf2 activation is necessary for SFN's effect.

slots.claim_sentence: SFN blocks HIV after the virus enters but before viral DNA forms 2-LTR circles.
slots.clarification_sentence: This stage is after reverse transcription but before viral DNA integrates into the host genome.

slots.claim_sentence: SFN does not increase levels of the antiviral proteins SAMHD1 or MX2.
Nrf2 can potently block HIV infection and SFN offers a new way to trigger this effect.

slots.clarification_sentence: PAQR-2 is similar to mammalian insulin-sensitizing adiponectin receptors.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers found paqr-2 suppressors by identifying mutations in genes for phosphatidylcholine synthesis and fatty acid metabolism.

slots.claim_sentence: Genetic evidence shows paqr-2, phosphatidylcholines, sbp-1, and Δ9-desaturases form a cold adaptation pathway.
slots.clarification_sentence: This pathway controls the increase of unsaturated fatty acids needed at low temperatures.

slots.claim_sentence: This pathway regulates the increase of unsaturated fatty acids to keep membranes fluid at low temperatures.
slots.clarification_sentence: Membrane fluidity prevents stiffness caused by cold in cell membranes.

slots.claim_sentence: The paqr-2 suppressors normalize the levels of saturated fatty acids in the worms.
Low concentrations of detergents that increase membrane fluidity can rescue the paqr-2 mutant.

slots.claim_sentence: Controlling Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus requires a rapid, economical tool to track sterilized males.
slots.clarification_sentence: Such tools help measure how well sterilized males spread and mate in the wild.

slots.claim_sentence: Rhodamine B is a fluorescent dye that stains insect bodies and seminal fluid when fed in sugar.
slots.clarification_sentence: Rhodamine B is thiol-reactive, allowing it to bind body tissue and seminal fluid.

slots.claim_sentence: This study adapted rhodamine B to mark male Aedes aegypti for rapid mating success assessment in field releases.
Feeding males 0.1% to 0.8% rhodamine B in 50% honey for 4 days marked over 95% of bodies and transferred dye to females.
The 0.4% and 0.8% rhodamine B solutions produced the longest-lasting body marking.
Rhodamine B marking did not affect male mating competitiveness and allowed transfer of marked seminal fluid to females in field tests.
slots.clarification_sentence: Field releases also showed marked males could be recaptured successfully.

slots.claim_sentence: Rhodamine B is a useful evaluation method for male-based SIT/IIT control and a viable body marking technique without negative side-effects.
Rhodamine B marking is less expensive and faster than PCR, stable isotope labelling, and female fertility assays for mating tests.

slots.claim_sentence: Gene retroposition creates significant genetic variation among individuals.

slots.clarification_sentence: Ancestral retrocopies are shared with other primates and can be lost in some human groups.

slots.claim_sentence: Retrocopy expression was measured using RNA-Seq data from the Illumina BodyMap and Geuvadis projects.

slots.claim_sentence: The study detected 193 retroduplication variations, mostly caused by retrocopy deletions.

slots.claim_sentence: Expression of 11 ancestral retrogenes deleted in some individuals was experimentally confirmed.

slots.claim_sentence: Deletion frequency is very low for 10 of these 11 expressed retrogenes.
slots.clarification_sentence: Low deletion frequency means these retrocopies are mostly preserved in populations.

slots.claim_sentence: The expression, conservation, and low deletion rate of these 10 retrocopies suggest possible functionality.
Nine retrogenes show statistically significant differences in expression between populations.
slots.clarification_sentence: These expression differences often occur between African and European groups.

slots.claim_sentence: Reactive oxygen species (ROS) are produced in the mitochondrial respiratory chain (RC).
slots.clarification_sentence: ROS act as signals for cell adaptation and can also damage cells under stress like hypoxia/reoxygenation.

slots.claim_sentence: Understanding how ROS are produced is important for cell survival.
slots.clarification_sentence: Details of the mechanisms and factors controlling ROS production remain unclear.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers extended a model of complex III to include the whole respiratory chain and related processes.
slots.clarification_sentence: The model covers electron transport, proton movement, electrochemical potential, TCA cycle, and substrate transport.

slots.claim_sentence: The model fits electron flux data from rat brain mitochondria fueled by succinate or pyruvate and malate.
slots.clarification_sentence: It also reproduces NAD+ reduction dynamics via reverse electron transport through complex I.

slots.claim_sentence: The model explains how free radicals form and transfer electrons to oxygen, starting ROS production.
slots.clarification_sentence: Free radicals create superoxide by passing unpaired electrons to oxygen molecules.

slots.claim_sentence: ROS production is linked to specific free radicals in complexes I and III of the respiratory chain.
slots.clarification_sentence: Different radicals from electron transporters contribute to ROS levels in these complexes.

slots.claim_sentence: Bistability, seen before in complex III, also occurs in the whole respiratory chain.
slots.clarification_sentence: This means the chain can stably exist in two states with different ROS levels under the same conditions.

slots.claim_sentence: Conditions causing complex III to switch to high free radical levels were predicted and confirmed experimentally.
slots.clarification_sentence: Changes like increased succinate or temporary hypoxia can trigger this switch to higher ROS production.

slots.claim_sentence: These findings provide new insight into how ROS are produced in the mitochondrial respiratory chain.

slots.claim_sentence: Oxidative stress can damage cell membranes.
slots.clarification_sentence: Membrane damage disrupts cellular compartment functions.

slots.claim_sentence: Lysosomes are sensitive to membrane damage because they need acidic pH and stable proton gradients.
slots.clarification_sentence: Lysosomes are acidic vesicles that support enzyme activity.

slots.claim_sentence: Apolipoprotein D (ApoD) is an extracellular lipid-binding protein with antioxidant capacity.
slots.clarification_sentence: ApoD is a stress-responsive lipocalin protein.

slots.claim_sentence: The cellular mechanism by which ApoD protects cells was previously unknown.
This study analyzed ApoD movement inside cells and its role in lysosomal pH during paraquat-induced oxidative stress.
ApoD is taken into cells and directed to vulnerable lysosomes when cells face stress.
slots.clarification_sentence: Only some lysosomes receive ApoD depending on their sensitivity to oxidative damage.

slots.claim_sentence: ApoD is stable in lysosomes and is needed for lysosomes to recover from oxidation-induced pH changes in astrocytes and neurons.
ApoD protects lysosomes by preventing their membrane from becoming permeable.
Lipoprotein regulation of lysosomal membrane integrity is a new mechanism important for many cell functions and neurodegenerative diseases.
These findings offer new therapeutic options by enabling lysosome repair in disease conditions.

slots.claim_sentence: The Dominican Republic had a Zika epidemic shortly after a large dengue epidemic.
slots.clarification_sentence: This timing allowed study of transmission differences between these two flaviviruses.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used retrospective datasets to study populations at risk nationwide.
slots.clarification_sentence: They applied descriptive statistics to describe the outbreaks on a national scale.

slots.claim_sentence: Seventy-five percent of dengue cases occurred in people under 20 years old.
slots.clarification_sentence: Zika infections were spread more widely across all age groups.

slots.claim_sentence: Dengue attack rates were slightly higher in males than females.
slots.clarification_sentence: Rates were 25.9 per 10,000 population in males versus 21.5 in females.

slots.claim_sentence: Zika infections were highly clustered among females in the Dominican Republic.
slots.clarification_sentence: Age-adjusted attack rates were 7.64 per 10,000 in females and 2.72 in males.

slots.claim_sentence: The reproductive number (R0) for Zika was higher in females than males.
slots.clarification_sentence: R0 was 1.84 for females and 1.72 for males, showing significant difference.

slots.claim_sentence: Existing dengue immunity had little effect on reported Zika attack rates at population level.
Community awareness campaigns likely increased Zika reporting among women of reproductive age.
slots.clarification_sentence: These campaigns influenced short-term health-seeking behavior, though biological susceptibility is not excluded.

slots.claim_sentence: Media campaigns and screening are recommended for women of reproductive age during Zika outbreaks.

slots.claim_sentence: A Markovian system is one where the future depends only on the present, not the past.

slots.clarification_sentence: These measures apply to continuous and non-Markovian systems without system perturbation.

slots.claim_sentence: ΦE and ΦAR enable studying information integration in real and model systems.
slots.clarification_sentence: This helps explore links between integrated information, consciousness, and cognitive processes.

slots.claim_sentence: The findings challenge theories that assign physical meaning to integrated information measures.
slots.clarification_sentence: Sensitivity to normalization questions the interpretation of these measures as fundamental quantities.

VGLL4 is important for heart valve development.
Manipulating Hippo pathway components could help prevent congenital valve disease progression.

slots.claim_sentence: Streptococcus pneumoniae meningitis is a common bacterial infection of the brain.
slots.clarification_sentence: It is the most common form of bacterial meningitis.

slots.claim_sentence: Pneumolysin is a key factor determining the damage caused by pneumococci.
People with pneumococcal meningitis show synaptic loss in the outer layers of the frontal brain.
Mice had similar synaptic loss only when bacteria produced pore-forming pneumolysin.
Pneumolysin at low, non-lytic levels caused dendritic swelling and synaptic loss in mouse brain slices.
slots.clarification_sentence: Dendrites are parts of neurons that receive signals, and their damage affects brain function.

slots.claim_sentence: Drugs blocking NMDA glutamate receptors reduced the damage caused by pneumolysin.
slots.clarification_sentence: NMDA receptors are brain proteins that respond to the neurotransmitter glutamate.

slots.claim_sentence: Pneumolysin increased glutamate levels in mouse brain slices.
Pneumolysin caused mouse astrocytes to release glutamate in a calcium-dependent way.
slots.clarification_sentence: Astrocytes are brain cells that help regulate neurotransmitters like glutamate.

slots.claim_sentence: Pneumolysin causes synaptic and dendritic damage by triggering glutamate release from astrocytes.
This study first shows that a bacterial toxin disrupts glutamate control, causing brain excitotoxic damage.
slots.clarification_sentence: Excitotoxic damage means nerve cells are harmed by excessive glutamate activity.

slots.claim_sentence: Diagnosis and treatment are crucial for controlling human African trypanosomiasis (HAT).
slots.clarification_sentence: HAT is caused mainly by the parasite Trypanosoma brucei gambiense.

slots.claim_sentence: Current rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) use native antigens that are difficult to produce.
slots.clarification_sentence: Producing native antigens requires a costly and risky process involving live parasites.

slots.claim_sentence: This study evaluated a new RDT called SD BIOLINE HAT 2.0 using recombinant antigens.
slots.clarification_sentence: Recombinant antigens are easier and safer to manufacture than native antigens.

slots.claim_sentence: The study screened 57,632 people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
slots.clarification_sentence: Screening was done passively at health centers and actively by mobile teams, confirming 260 HAT cases by parasitology.

slots.claim_sentence: SD BIOLINE HAT 2.0 had the highest sensitivity at 71.2%, outperforming CATT and SD BIOLINE HAT.
CATT was the most specific test with 99.2% specificity.
slots.clarification_sentence: SD BIOLINE HAT and SD BIOLINE HAT 2.0 had specificities of 98.9% and 98.1%, respectively.

slots.claim_sentence: Combining SD BIOLINE HAT with SD BIOLINE HAT 2.0 increased sensitivity to 98.4% in passive screening.
slots.clarification_sentence: Combination also improved sensitivity to 83.0% in active screening.

slots.claim_sentence: Using two or more tests improves sensitivity but slightly reduces specificity.
slots.clarification_sentence: Further research is needed on the practicality and cost-effectiveness of combined screening.

slots.claim_sentence: Chagas disease has been effectively controlled in Guatemala through multiple rounds of indoor residual insecticide spraying.
slots.clarification_sentence: Control efforts have focused on eliminating triatomine vectors from homes using IRS.

slots.claim_sentence: Some areas in Guatemala still have persistent Triatoma dimidiata infestation despite control efforts.
The municipality of Comapa in Guatemala has persistent Triatoma dimidiata infestation where control interventions appear less effective.
Three cross-sectional entomological and serological surveys were done in Comapa to evaluate a decade of vector control activities.
The infestation index in Comapa decreased significantly from 39% in 2001–2 to 27% in 2011 after multiple rounds of indoor residual sprayings.
slots.clarification_sentence: Indoor residual spraying alone did not reduce infestation below 15% in these communities.

slots.claim_sentence: Chagas seroprevalence in school-aged children in Comapa declined ten-fold from 10% in 1999 to 1% in 2015.
Seroprevalence in women of child-bearing age in Comapa remains greater than 10%.
The continued risk for vector-borne and congenital transmission threatens the 2022 Chagas disease elimination goal.
Systematic integrated vector control and improved screening and treatment programs are needed to reach the elimination goal in areas with persistent infestation.

slots.claim_sentence: 5’-3’ decay is the main mRNA decay pathway in many eukaryotes, including trypanosomes.
slots.clarification_sentence: This pathway controls gene expression by breaking down messenger RNA molecules.

slots.claim_sentence: Trypanosomes lack all subunits of the usual decapping complex, but keep deadenylation and 5’-3’ degradation.
slots.clarification_sentence: Trypanosomes must have evolved a different mechanism for mRNA decapping.

slots.claim_sentence: Trypanosomes use an ApaH-like phosphatase called ALPH1 as their main mRNA decapping enzyme.
Removing ALPH1 is lethal and causes deadenylated mRNAs to accumulate without starting 5’-3’ decay.
ALPH1 acts after deadenylation and before mRNA degradation, consistent with decapping.
Lab tests show truncated ALPH1 makes capped RNA sensitive to yeast Xrn1 only with RNA 5’ polyphosphatase.
slots.clarification_sentence: This means ALPH1 alone cannot fully prepare RNA for degradation by Xrn1.

slots.claim_sentence: ALPH1’s decapping leaves multiple phosphate groups at the mRNA’s 5’ end, unlike Dcp2.
ALPH1 is the first eukaryotic ApaH-like phosphatase with a known function.

slots.claim_sentence: Little is known about how associative learning between cues and visuomotor mappings generalises to novel conditions.
Participants performed a rapid target-pointing task with manipulated offsets between visual feedback and movement end-points.
slots.clarification_sentence: This manipulation simulated different visuomotor mappings by changing the spatial feedback of pointing movements.

slots.claim_sentence: The visual feedback had horizontal offsets that varied depending on the target's shape.
slots.clarification_sentence: Participants had to adjust their motor response differently for each target shape to hit it.

slots.claim_sentence: Target shapes formed a continuous set morphed between spiky and circular forms.
slots.clarification_sentence: This allowed study of learning generalisation across similar but untrained shapes.

slots.claim_sentence: After training, participants were tested without feedback on novel target shapes not seen before.
slots.clarification_sentence: This tested how well learned visuomotor mappings generalised to new shapes.

slots.claim_sentence: Learning required explicit awareness of cues, and participants applied the mapping of the trained shape most similar to the current one.
slots.clarification_sentence: This pattern matched predictions from the Bayesian learning model.

slots.claim_sentence: The Bayesian model predicted learning would slow down with more training pairs, which the results confirmed.
slots.clarification_sentence: More shape-mapping pairs caused interference, reducing learning speed.

slots.claim_sentence: The Bayesian learning model corresponded well with results, suggesting it explains learning multiple visuomotor mappings.
